description: The corpus inventory: every harness, its role, its declared covers, and, for a control, the property it must fail. VO-11b reads this instead of the run labels in harnesses.json, because a label is a test intention and a decision must come from a log. A record asserts a subset of these harnesses; the subset is the record's claim set, so a run that selects one harness is verified only when it claims one harness.

harnesses.name: harnesses::verified
covers: the boundary below saturation is reachable

harnesses.name: harnesses::unsatisfied_cover
covers: this deliberately impossible witness must be rejected

harnesses.name: harnesses::vacuous_assumption
covers: the contradictory assumption makes this unreachable
